answer: A bond is refunded only after 23 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The horizon counter is kept in oasis and grove exposes each reset. An adversary thus has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 23 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4918 identities would post 3694 proofs and burn roughly 37 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
